move: light sweeps across headline, button and stat card; marker underline draws
how: A dark hero layout: headline with one word wrapped in a yellow marker stroke, body copy, a white button and a stat card. A full-frame overlay gradient sweeps xPercent -110 to 110 with power2.inOut over 0.35 D, twice per loop; skewed sheen bands follow it across the headline, then the button, then the card, each 0.7-0.9s with the same ease. The marker path DrawSVGs in behind the key word at 0.175 D with power3.out and wipes away at 0.83 D with power3.in; the card ring flashes on with expo.out and the stat number pops scale 1.08 with back.out(3) twice.
adapt: Replace headline, highlighted word, body, button and stat text, the marker colour and stroke width; add or remove sheen targets. Keep the sweep-then-local-sheen order and the draw-then-wipe on the marker so the loop closes.
port: mount(el, shot) injects the layout with sheen divs and the marker SVG; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with sweep times at 0.025 D and 0.575 D and sheens following, selectors scoped to el. DrawSVGPlugin must be registered.
caveats: mix-blend-mode screen and overlay layers over text
